items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1960-11-03
items.q: The name 'Paul' appears only in the interviewer's question: 'Would you say it was better than the other bands at that time? No. It wasn't? Was there anything that made it outstanding, Paul?' The interviewee does not mention Paul, nor does he respond to a question about a person named Paul.

ctx.x: Yeah, better tone and more easy to play. Yeah.

I'm going to ask you something about those... Remember, we were talking a week or two ago about... About when you played with Baldwin. No. Remember you were telling me how you used to play with Baldwin? What kind of system clarinet did you play then? Was it the Albert system? Albert. Yeah, those old days. Yeah. Oh. What did you like about the Baldwin band in particular? Was it a special band? Would you say it was better than the other bands at that time? No. It wasn't? Was there anything that made it outstanding,…

Yeah. Oh, my. Great friends. Good friends. They all left me by myself. So far, is that Albert Glennon? His word was, Who fall down, stay down? He fall down, stay down. Stay down. That was his word. Who Glennie? Yeah, I was Glennie. How do you say that? He died not so long ago. Yes, I knew him quite well, too. He made some records once with him playing bass. And he was a great bass player. Good musician. And a good painter to trade. A painter. He used to climb a ladder. He used to climb a ladder. High 60 feet. Oh,…
